description.value:
Duration constant

Grace accumulates slightly faster from qualifying acts of endurance.

When you would gain Grace from a qualifying act of endurance — holding a position, refusing to abandon someone, suffering rather than yielding — you progress toward your next point as though you had performed two such acts. This does not raise your cap and does not apply to qualifying acts of other kinds.
